content: The brand was established by José Pepin Garcia and is produced at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. The name of the brand is derived from the Sancti Spíritus province in Cuba, where Don Pepin's hometown of Cabaiguán is situated. The brand features a single line of four vitolas. The cigar is classified as medium-bodied. Its filler and binder are composed of Nicaraguan tobaccos, while the wrapper is made from Nicaraguan Corojo. The band design is inspired by the Cuban flag and depicts a scene from the Plaza Mayor in the city of Trinidad, prominently featuring the statue of Terpsichore, the Greek Muse of dance and dramatic chorus. The cigars are packaged in boxes containing 25 units.
